name: Corporate Action Date SD 4
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action date details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: xPath to the element that is being extended.

InterimAccountingStartDate.name: Interim Accounting Start Date
InterimAccountingStartDate.definition: Date on which accounting for due bills starts and associated tracking begins.

DelistingDate.name: Delisting Date
DelistingDate.definition: Date on which the event security is no longer listed on the exchange.

ExercisePeriodBeginDate.name: Exercise Period Begin Date
ExercisePeriodBeginDate.definition: Date by which a holder can exercise warrants.

ObjectionDate.name: Objection Date
ObjectionDate.definition: Date by which a holder listed as a member of the claimant group in a lawsuit may object to the proposed solution.

ExclusionDate.name: Exclusion Date
ExclusionDate.definition: Date by which claimants may exclude themselves from an ongoing class action lawsuit.

ProofOfClaimFilingDate.name: Proof Of Claim Filing Date
ProofOfClaimFilingDate.definition: Date by which a holder must file claim forms to become a member of the claimant group in a lawsuit.
